title: Goosestraße, Bremen
description:
Groundfloor, 2-room, 4-bed furnished, suitable for sharing, at Goosestr.51, 28237 Bremen.
This apartment is located on Goosestr. 51, a relatively quiet area.  Very close to the waterfront centre of Bremen. Blessed with good commercial city transport links. 

Each room is equipped with 2 single beds of 2m x .90m. The rooms are furnished with wardrobes, 2 stools, a reading/writing table and a small night table.

One room faces the street while the other faces the garden.

The apartment has a equipped kitchen and a bathroom with shower.  

The apartment has access to the house WLAN.
